read.thesis: Record Q4 postpaid phone adds of 903,000 and raised 2025 service revenue growth to about 5%, but no capacity or capex-cycle signal; core EBITDA guide $33.1–33.6B and cash capex about $9.5B.

capex.quote: We expect cash CapEx to be approximately $9.5 billion as we outlined for you at our Capital Markets Day

triggers.label: Service revenue growth ~5% (from 4%)
triggers.quote: approximately 5% growth in service revenue for the full year, up from the 4% we indicated during our Capital Markets Day

triggers.label: Postpaid ARPA growth ~3% in 2025
triggers.quote: postpaid ARPA growth of around 3% for the full year

triggers.label: Q4 postpaid phone net adds 903,000
triggers.quote: we once again led the industry in postpaid phone net additions with 903,000

triggers.label: Wholesale decline bottoms in 2025
triggers.quote: 2025 would be the low point for wholesale revenue and with growth thereafter

guidance.quote: we expect to deliver total postpaid customer net additions of between 5.5 million and 6 million
approximately 5% growth in service revenue for the full year, up from the 4% we indicated
postpaid ARPA growth of around 3% for the full year
we expect core adjusted EBITDA to be between $33.1 billion and $33.6 billion for the full year
We expect cash CapEx to be approximately $9.5 billion
we now expect adjusted free cash flow, including payments for merger-related costs, in the range of $17.3 billion to $18 billion

red_flags.label: Wholesale decline from DISH/TracFone
red_flags.quote: as they build their own network and offload off of our network that we would see the tapering of those 2 ultimately going to 0

evasions.topic: Aggregate EBITDA and FCF impact of pending M&A
evasions.quote: I think it's a little premature for a number of reasons for me to give you what does the aggregate look like
